questions.question: Is the applicant between 45–60 years of age?
Is the applicant a naturalized citizen?
Does the applicant hold a relevant academic qualification?
Does the applicant have ≥10 years relevant experience?
Have you at any time been charged with or convicted of any offence or otherwise found liable by a Civil, Criminal or Military Court (excluding minor road traffic offences), in any jurisdiction?
Was there a time when you were not in compliance with any tax or other statutory requirements imposed on you?  (Section 3(1)(iii) of the Act)

Has any loan or credit facility (or part thereof) extended to you by any financial institution, been restructured, renegotiated, provided against or been the subject of a write-off or debt forgiveness for reasons of non-payment by you?

Do you (in your personal capacity), or through any legal person or arrangement controlled by you and/or any immediate relative have outstanding any loans or other forms of indebtedness (including guarantees) in excess of N$2.5mn?
Have you ever been or are you currently a Director of any limited liability companies, societies, or other business enterprises engaged in financial services, as defined in the BSA?

Are you a beneficial owner of a controlling interest (20% or more of the voting shares, or the ability to appoint or remove a majority of the board) in any financial institution, partnerships, societies, or trust corporations or other body, organization or entity whether for business, benevolent or other purposes?
Will you be actively engaged in the business of the Licensee to which this application relates and devote the major portion of your time thereto?

If you are completing this form in the capacity of director or proposed director, please indicate whether you have or will have any executive responsibility for the management of the institution’s business
questions.not_applicable_reason: Non-executive appointment. The question addresses executive responsibility for the management of the institution and does not apply to this role.

questions.question: Are any shares of the Licensee registered in your name?
Are any shares of the Licensee registered in the name of an immediate relative?

Have you acquainted yourself with and do you understand the extent of the rights and powers, as well as your responsibilities and duties, as a director, officer or key employee or a proposed director, officer or key employee of the institution for which this questionnaire is being completed, as contained in the applicable law, regulations, and guidelines?

cv_verification.analysis_prompt:
You are reviewing a CV submitted as part of a fit and proper application. You have the CV document (cv_document) and three values already established from the applicant's primary evidence: authenticated_qualification, authenticated_experience, and authenticated_directorships. You also have the role being applied for (proposed_role).

Read the CV and extract: the qualifications claimed, the employment history with employer, title, and start/end dates for each position, and any directorships, board memberships, or significant ownership positions mentioned.

Produce two lists.

consistency_findings — one entry per comparison below. For each, state the verdict CONSISTENT or EVIDENCE_CONFLICT and a one-sentence detail citing the specific figures that agree or disagree. If the CV does not mention a given point at all, treat it as CONSISTENT: silence is not a conflict, only a stated disagreement is.
  1. qualification — compare the CV's stated qualification, institution and year against authenticated_qualification.
  2. experience — compare the CV's stated current and recent employer, title, and dates against authenticated_experience.
  3. directorships — compare the CV's stated directorships or board positions against authenticated_directorships in both directions: note anything the CV claims that the authenticated record does not show, and anything material the authenticated record shows that the CV omits.

suitability_findings — one entry per judgment below. For each, state the verdict NO_CONCERN or SUITABILITY_FLAG and a one or two sentence rationale grounded only in what the CV states. These are judgments for a human reviewer, not authentication failures — do not treat a SUITABILITY_FLAG as evidence of dishonesty.
  1. sector_relevance — is the applicant's professional background in a sector relevant to banking or financial services, given proposed_role?
  2. seniority_level — has the applicant operated at a level of seniority or scope (executive committee, board, head-office strategic responsibility) consistent with a director-level appointment, or only at a regional or operational level?
  3. career_gaps — are there unexplained gaps of a year or more in the employment timeline?

Return only the two lists in the structured output format. Do not include any finding not grounded in the CV text or the supplied reference values.
cv_verification.scoring_impact: none — reviewer-facing only; does not affect the fit and proper score or reopen the correction loop
